_comment: Copy this file to config/config.json (gitignored) and replace the placeholders with your real test sites, then run: python scripts/seed_sites.py. Each entry becomes one item in the Sites DynamoDB table. checkIntervalSec is recorded per site for future use; Phase 1 sweeps every enabled site once a minute regardless. isPublic defaults to false: only sites set to true appear on the unauthenticated public status page (public.html), everything else needs a dashboard login.
